correctness.rationale: The multivariate Cayley identity counts all exact labeled degree vectors. A rank-one reduced-Laplacian forest determinant enumerates each fixed marked path; exact multinomial coefficient extraction and a symmetric-sum identity telescope to P(D>k)=k!e_k(b)/(N)_k, including the terminal case. The Robin-Hood identity e_k(new)-e_k(old)=(x-y-1)e_{k-2}(rest) proves full stochastic order and strict threshold two. The extremal majorization profiles and means follow exactly. A standalone independently constructed Prüfer enumeration verified n=2..8 and 1,991,963 exact assertions; this is corroboration, not infinite proof.

value.rationale: Fixed-degree labeled Cayley trees and path lengths between designated vertices are canonical probabilistic geometric objects. The result is an exact all-threshold structural comparison and complete extremal degree-profile classification under fixed endpoint degrees. It gives explicit sharp expectation bounds, the unique equality classes, and comparison of genuinely positive-coordinate balancing transfers; these go beyond a one-off moment calculation, familiar unconditional Rayleigh limit, or a routine value substitution.
